1. Test Case ID: phNh02

- JSON deserialization error

    Response contains invalid JSON (lone Unicode surrogate characters are not valid per RFC 8259):

      Failed to get UTF-8 representation: UnicodeEncodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't encode character '\udbe2' in position 18: surrogates not allowed

[400] Bad Request:

    `{"error":"Invalid JSON","details":"Unexpected token '\udbe2', \"􈣈\" is not valid JSON"}`

Reproduce with:

    curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '􈣈' http://127.0.0.1:5001/api/colors
